title: 真实外部URL权限边界：没有INSERT仍可取外部数据，只撤销指定分析账号的URL读取
answer:
```python
import re
def restrict_url(admin,user):
    if not isinstance(user,str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}',user):raise ValueError('explicit bounded analyst name required')
    admin('REVOKE READ ON URL FROM '+user)
```

原题知识说明：
盘点表函数、外部数据源与网络访问权限，按允许名单和最小授权控制。用经批准的越界测试确认被拒绝，并检查秘密不出现在查询日志，不能仅撤销INSERT。
source: OpsForge 原创编审 2026-10-21；ClickHouse官方文档核对

body:
## 操作任务
实现restrict_url(admin,user)，user为1..32位小写字母开头、小写字母数字下划线的明确分析账号，否则ValueError且不调用admin。admin(sql)操作隔离测试实例：仅撤销该账号URL数据源读取授权，保留其已有default.events SELECT、CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE、全部其他设置和其他账号原权限。不能仅撤销INSERT、撤销ALL或关闭全局网络。原生验收先证明无INSERT的分析账号仍能通过url()读取本地HTTP测试源；收紧后应在HTTP请求发出前ACCESS_DENIED，批准本地SELECT和临时表仍成功，另一既有服务账号与原管理身份URL访问保持。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实ClickHouse25.8.1.5101和私有回环HTTP源；REVOKE READ ON URL在该版本规范化SHOW GRANTS为URL权限。仅隔离账号指定URL能力收紧，不更改外部默认身份，不代表所有file/remote/S3路径、全局出口白名单或查询日志脱敏已验收。测试URL无凭据，未连接任意外部站点。

"""Real pinned ClickHouse Local engine; private catalog, small pools and no network."""
import json,os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,tempfile

CONFIG='''<clickhouse>
 <logger><level>error</level><console>1</console></logger>
 <max_thread_pool_size>64</max_thread_pool_size>
 <background_schedule_pool_size>4</background_schedule_pool_size>
 <background_buffer_flush_schedule_pool_size>1</background_buffer_flush_schedule_pool_size>
 <background_message_broker_schedule_pool_size>1</background_message_broker_schedule_pool_size>
 <background_distributed_schedule_pool_size>1</background_distributed_schedule_pool_size>
 <background_pool_size>2</background_pool_size>
 <merge_tree>
  <number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_execute_mutation>0</number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_execute_mutation>
  <number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_lower_max_size_of_merge>0</number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_lower_max_size_of_merge>
  <number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_execute_optimize_entire_partition>0</number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_execute_optimize_entire_partition>
 </merge_tree>
</clickhouse>'''

class Local:
 def __init__(self):
  self.executable=shutil.which('clickhouse')
  if not self.executable:raise RuntimeError('NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: ClickHouse Local 25.8.1.5101 executable missing')
  result=subprocess.run([self.executable,'local','--version'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3)
  if result.returncode or '25.8.1.5101' not in result.stdout:raise RuntimeError('NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: pinned ClickHouse Local version required')
 def __enter__(self):
  self.temp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-clickhouse-');self.root=pathlib.Path(self.temp.name);self.config=self.root/'config.xml';self.config.write_text(CONFIG,encoding='utf8');return self
 def run(self,sql,*,data=None,structure=None,table='source',input_format='JSONEachRow'):
  args=[self.executable,'local','--config-file='+str(self.config),'--path='+str(self.root/'data'),'--multiquery','--format=JSONEachRow',
   '--max_threads=2','--max_memory_usage=134217728','--output_format_json_quote_64bit_integers=0','--query='+sql]
  if data is not None:args+=['--structure='+structure,'--input-format='+input_format,'--table='+table]
  try:result=subprocess.run(args,input=data,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15,cwd=self.root,env={**os.environ,'HOME':str(self.root),'TMPDIR':str(self.root)})
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:raise AssertionError('native ClickHouse query exceeded isolated budget') from error
  assert result.returncode==0,'native ClickHouse SQL failed: '+result.stderr[-2500:]
  try:return [json.loads(line) for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
  except ValueError as error:raise AssertionError('native result was not JSONEachRow') from error
 def __exit__(self,*args):self.temp.cleanup()

import os,sys,pathlib,threading,secrets
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler,HTTPServer
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from ch_server import Server
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
seen=[]
class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 def do_GET(self):
  seen.append(self.path);body=b'17\n23\n';self.send_response(200);self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(body)
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
hook=HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler);thread=threading.Thread(target=hook.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
try:
 with Server() as server:
  user='analyst_'+secrets.token_hex(4);other='service_'+secrets.token_hex(4)
  server.execute('CREATE TABLE events(id UInt32,value UInt32) ENGINE=Memory');server.execute('INSERT INTO events VALUES(1,7),(2,11),(3,19)')
  for name in (user,other):
   server.execute('CREATE USER '+name);server.execute('GRANT SELECT ON default.events TO '+name);server.execute('GRANT CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE ON *.* TO '+name);server.execute('GRANT READ ON URL TO '+name)
  url='http://127.0.0.1:'+str(hook.server_port)+'/approved-probe'
  query="SELECT sum(value) FROM url('"+url+"','TSV','value UInt32')"
  expected_local='1\t7\n2\t11\n3\t19\n'
  assert server.execute('SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY id',user=user)==expected_local
  assert server.execute(query,user=user)=='40\n' and seen,'SELECT-only local grants do not define external source rights'
  old_grants=server.execute('SHOW GRANTS FOR '+user).splitlines();old_other=server.execute('SHOW GRANTS FOR '+other)
  try:server.execute('INSERT INTO events VALUES(4,999)',user=user)
  except AssertionError as error:assert 'ACCESS_DENIED' in str(error)
  else:raise AssertionError('baseline analyst already had write rights')
  print('NATIVE_CLICKHOUSE_NO_INSERT_BUT_URL_SOURCE_STILL_READABLE',flush=True)
  print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:restrict_url',flush=True)
  try:task.restrict_url(server.execute,user)
  except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student source privilege operation failed') from error
  hits=len(seen)
  try:server.execute(query,user=user)
  except AssertionError as error:assert 'ACCESS_DENIED' in str(error),'not an authorization denial'
  else:raise AssertionError('external URL source still readable after remediation')
  assert len(seen)==hits,'unauthorized URL was fetched before privilege rejection'
  assert server.execute('SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY id',user=user)==expected_local,'approved local SELECT lost'
  assert server.execute('CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE approved_temp(v UInt32) ENGINE=Memory',user=user)==''
  expected_grants=[r for r in old_grants if not r.startswith('GRANT URL ON ')]
  assert server.execute('SHOW GRANTS FOR '+user).splitlines()==expected_grants,'unrelated analyst grant changed'
  assert server.execute('SHOW GRANTS FOR '+other)==old_other
  assert server.execute(query,user=other)=='40\n' and server.execute(query)=='40\n','approved existing other identities lost URL access'
  approved=server.execute('SHOW GRANTS FOR '+user)
  calls=[]
  for bad in ('','UPPER','analyst; DROP TABLE events','a'*33,None):
   try:task.restrict_url(calls.append,bad)
   except ValueError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError('unbounded/interpolated analyst name accepted')
  assert calls==[] and server.execute('SHOW GRANTS FOR '+user)==approved
  assert server.execute('SELECT count(),sum(value) FROM events')=='3\t37\n'
  print('NATIVE_CLICKHOUSE_URL_DENIED_BEFORE_FETCH_LOCAL_READS_TEMP_AND_OTHER_IDENTITIES_PRESERVED',flush=True)
finally:hook.shutdown();hook.server_close();thread.join(2)
assert not thread.is_alive()
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
